title: 第27 章 火脉洞
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
三日后，天刚蒙蒙亮。

    陈青山揣着两块牌，顺着器峰东侧的山道往下走。

    一块是功德殿给的清灰对牌，木头牌子，边角磨得扎手。一块是周伯给的临时牌，黑乎乎的，贴在胸口，越往下走越热。

    山道尽头裂着一道石缝。

    石缝两边烧得发红，外头竖着半截铁牌，上面三个字歪歪扭扭。

    火脉洞。

    还没进去，热气先扑过来，陈青山喉咙一干，差点咳出声。

    他赶紧低头，把咳声压住。

    洞口蹲着几个杂役，衣襟敞着，脸上脖子上都是灰。有个老杂役抱着陶罐喝水，喝完还拿手指抠了抠嗓子，骂了一句：“娘的，今天这火又冲。”

    旁边人笑：“嫌冲你别来啊。”

    “老子不来，你替老子还赌债？”

    几个人哄笑。

    陈青山听着，心里反倒松了一点。

    能骂人，能开荤笑话，说明还没被这地方烤成鬼。

    “新来的？”

    洞口里头摆着张矮桌，一个赤着半边膀子的壮汉抬眼看他。壮汉肩膀很宽，脸上有道旧烫疤，疤边皱巴巴的，像被火舔过一口。

    陈青山递上对牌：“陈青山，接了清废炉赤焰灰的差事，今日点卯。”

    壮汉翻了翻名册。

    “练气三层后期？”

    “是。”

    “穷疯了？”

    这话问得太直接，旁边几个杂役都乐了。

    陈青山也不装硬气，苦笑一下：“差不多。”

    壮汉拿炭笔在册子上一点：“方大河。外炉这片归我管。规矩先听好，每日清灰三炉，少一炉扣半日工钱。偷拿赤焰矿粉，断手。乱碰炉底火脉，炸了炉，赔命。”

    陈青山点头：“记下了。”

    “别光嘴上记。”方大河拿炭笔敲了敲桌子，“炉灰里有红的，有黑的，有发亮的，看见也别伸手。真想发财，去外头挖矿，别在我这儿找死。”

    红的，黑的，发亮的。

    陈青山眼皮没抬。

    好嘛，重点都给划出来了。

    他嘴上只道：“我就挣工钱。”

    “都这么说。”方大河嗤了一声，把桌上一只黑石盘推出来，“先测控火。没点控火底子，铲子伸进去，手就熟了。”

    石盘中间嵌着一块灰白石头，上面四圈纹，外头往里刻着赤、橙、金、紫。

    陈青山一看就懂了。

    火鉴石。

    赤色能干杂活，橙色能靠近炉口，金色估计就算不错。紫色不用想，那是内堂炼器苗子才该有的颜色。

    他不能差，也不能太好。

    七成。

    还得抖一点，不能稳。

    方大河见他不动，皱眉：“怕了？怕就滚。现在滚，功德殿那边顶多记你弃工。”

    旁边有人插嘴：“方头儿，你别吓他。上回那个李小耳，手刚按上去就喊娘，比他还怂。”

    “李小耳那是喊娘吗？他是被灰呛得找不着北。”

    陈青山搓了搓手，像是真被说得没底气：“方管事，我以前只在废器炉边添过炭，控火不算好。”

    “废器炉？”

    “废器处理组，打杂，记炉温，递炭。”
content_en:
Three days later, it was dawn.

    Chen Qingshan carried two cards and walked down the mountain path on the east side of Qi Peak.

    One is a pair of wooden plaques given by the Gongde Palace, and its corners are worn to the point of scratching your finger. One is a temporary card given by Uncle Zhou. It is dark and sticks to the chest. The further it goes down, the hotter it gets.

    There is a crack in the stone at the end of the mountain road.

    Both sides of the stone seam were burning red, and there was half an iron sign standing outside, with three crooked words on it.

    Fire Vein Cave.

    Before he entered, the heat hit him first. Chen Qingshan's throat went dry and he almost coughed.

    He quickly lowered his head to suppress his cough.

    There were several handymen squatting at the entrance of the cave, their clothes were open, and their faces and necks were covered in ashes. There was an old handyman who was drinking water from a clay pot. After drinking, he picked his throat with his fingers and cursed: "Damn, I'm so angry again today."

    The person next to me laughed and said, "Don't come here if it's offensive to you."

    "If I don't come, will you pay off my gambling debt?"

    Several people laughed.

    Chen Qingshan felt a little relieved after hearing this.

    Being able to curse people and make dirty jokes means that he hasn't been roasted into a ghost by this place.

    "New here?"

    There was a low table at the entrance of the cave, and a strong man with half his arms raised his eyes to look at him. The strong man had broad shoulders and an old burn scar on his face. The edges of the scar were wrinkled, as if he had been licked by fire.

    Chen Qingshan handed over the pair of cards: "Chen Qingshan, I took over the task of clearing the red flames and ashes of the waste furnace. I will do it today."

    The strong man flipped through the roster.

    "Later stage of the third level of Qi training?"

    "Yes."

    "Are you crazy about being poor?"

    This question was so direct that the servants nearby were very happy.

    Chen Qingshan did not pretend to be tough and smiled bitterly: "Absolutely."

    The strong man took a charcoal pencil and wrote something on the book: "Fang Dahe. I am in charge of the outer furnace. Listen to the rules first. Clean three furnaces a day, and half a day's wages will be deducted for one furnace less. Steal the red flame ore powder and cut off your hand. Touch the fire veins at the bottom of the furnace and blow up the furnace. You will pay for your life."

    Chen Qingshan nodded: "Remember it."

    "Don't just keep writing." Fang Dahe knocked on the table with a charcoal pen. "There are red, black, and shiny things in the ashes. Don't reach out if you see them. If you really want to make a fortune, go mining outside. Don't seek death here."

    Red, black, shiny.

    Chen Qingshan did not raise his eyelids.

    Okay, the key points have been highlighted.

    He just said: "I just earn wages."

    "That's what they say." Fang Dahe snorted and pushed out a black stone plate on the table, "Test and control the fire first. If you don't touch the base of the fire control, put the shovel in and your hands will become familiar."

    There is a gray-white stone embedded in the middle of the stone plate, with four circles on it, and red, orange, gold, and purple engraved from the outside to the inside.

    Chen Qingshan understood it at a glance.

    Fire identification stone.

    Red is good for doing chores, orange is good for getting closer to the stove, and gold is probably good. Don't think about purple, it is the color that only the inner hall's weapon-refining seedlings should have.

    He can't be bad, nor can he be too good.

    Seventy percent.

    It still has to shake a little, and it's not stable.

    Seeing that he was not moving, Fang Dahe frowned: "Are you afraid? If you're afraid, just get out. Get out now. The most you can do in the Hall of Merit will be your abandonment of work."

    Someone next to him interrupted: "Fang Tou'er, don't scare him. That Li Xiaoer last time called me mother as soon as I put my hand on him. She was even more cowardly than him."

    "Is Li Xiaoer calling me mother? He was so choked with ashes that he couldn't find his way."

    Chen Qingshan rubbed his hands, as if he was really discouraged: "Manager Fang, I have only added charcoal to the waste furnace before, and it is not good at controlling the fire."

    "Waste furnace?"

    "The waste disposal team does miscellaneous tasks, records furnace temperatures, and delivers charcoal."
